name: Nakazawa Erena
source:
The person who accused the protagonist of being a molester. Her personality is solitary and self-centered. She thinks that all men will bow down to her, and makes the men who make advances on her pay. She is a student, but rarely goes to school and just likes to hang out.

[From [url=https://www.debonosu.jp/euphoria/game/soy_rankaku/character.html]Official site[/url]]
